text: Medicines are active drugs used to preserve health (treating sick animals or preventing disease in a herd/flock) and to improve production (better reproduction, more meat, more milk); efficacy and safety are the main concerns in their use. A simplified categorization: vitamins and minerals (for health, growth, reproduction); antibiotics (fight bacterial infection); anti-parasite medicines (skin, digestive/respiratory tract, and blood parasites); anti-inflammatory/analgesic medicines (inflammation, fever, pain); hormones (genitals and reproduction); vaccines (mainly prevent viral disease); disinfectants (control bacteria, virus, fungi in the environment); and antidotes (treat poisoning and medicine overdoses).
